meta.what: Round 7: attempts to narrow the 90% band of the no-war path for 'paid to Russia' (to_rus) of the 13 widest-range countries (KGZ ARM TJK GEO MNG KAZ UZB SYR SEN COG BIH SVK YEM). Five ideas tested; per-ISO entries only where the new 2022-2026 band is narrower (by >= 5%) and still calibrated. All other countries keep today's band (counterfactual.json / cf_bands.json).
meta.effect_note: effect_on_map_pct_gdp: width of the counterfactual term alone, low side / high side, % of GDP. 'brief' = the table in the round-7 brief (data.json before the 14:00 rebuild); 'new ... on brief basis' scales it by the change in band; 'live' uses site/data.json as of 2026-10-18 14:00 (its to_rus bmul central changed with energy_nowar.json, so its se differs).
meta.units: Multipliers, real terms, as cf_bands.json: multiplier_vs_2021 per year (2026 as an annual rate); cumulative_band = multiplier on the SUM over the horizon of the expected (central) level, H5_2026_8of12 = 2022-2026 with 2026 at 8/12.
meta.how_to_apply: For the listed ISO3s: cb[1..5] = cumulative_band H1..H4 and H5_2026_8of12 (multipliers on the summed central expected level, so they apply unchanged whatever the central path is, including the no-war price factor that energy_nowar.json folded into bmul). Yearly: bmul_lo = bmul x multiplier_vs_2021.low, bmul_hi = bmul x multiplier_vs_2021.high (ratios to the yearly central). Base, base_range and actuals unchanged. No central change: the volume path stays the 2021 level.
meta.decision_rule_models: a model replaces the 2021-held path only if it beats it on average (median absolute log error, origins 2007, 2012, 2016) and is not worse at any origin
meta.decision_rule_bands: a band replaces today's only if (a) the 2022-2026 band is >= 5% narrower, (b) it is calibrated by era (two eras x K cover >= 90% of the third) and covers >= 85% of the held-out generic test windows, (c) it covers >= 90% of the country's own rolling 5-year windows and all of its own test windows

KGZ.method: 2021 level held (random walk). Interval: 90% band of the size class (L) measured on rolling origins 2005-2020 (all years kept, 2009, 2014-15 and 2020 included; targets to 2021), 5th-95th percentile of the 1-5 year cumulative random-walk errors x K = 1.1, K set so that bands from two eras of origins cover >= 90% of the third era (2005-09, 2010-12, 2013-16). Replaces the band from the three back-tests (cf_bands.json B1).

notes: Only one idea narrows the band honestly: re-measuring the size-class band on rolling origins 2005-2020 with an era calibration (ideas 4-5 combined). It is 7% narrower for large flows and 12% for mid-size flows; for large flows the low side gets slightly wider (0.570 against 0.608) and the high side clearly narrower (1.617 against 1.737).

Applied to KGZ, TJK, KAZ, SVK (L) and GEO, SEN (M): the six listed countries whose own 5-year windows and own back-test windows it covers. ARM, UZB, SYR and BIH fail that check (their history has 5-year sums above the new high side), MNG, YEM and COG would get wider bands.

The rolling band would serve every L and M country equally; applying it to the six only is the brief's rule. For consistency the builder may prefer to apply it to all L and M countries (all pass the size-class calibration; per-country checks were run only for the 13).

Per-year bands from the same rolling data are WIDER than today's in single years (L 2022: 0.66-1.44 against 0.70-1.35), because rolling origins keep 2009, 2014-15 and 2020; only the 2022-2026 band narrows.

Fuel split (idea 1): fuel and other-goods errors are almost uncorrelated and each is wider than the total; the energy-balance model does not reduce the fuel error. Generic decision rule failed. For the neighbour group (ARM AZE BLR GEO KAZ KGZ MDA MNG TJK TKM UZB) fuel-by-energy-use plus other-goods-by-IMF-forecast passes (+32%, +26%, +26%), but it raises the central (2022-2026 sum x1.08 to x1.28) without narrowing the band; not used.

Own-history bands (idea 4) cannot be calibrated: two eras of a country's own history cover the third era at 60-85% for any K up to 3, also among countries whose own history looks narrow. The own bands already in cf_bands.json for MNG and YEM rest on that method; they cover their own windows (12/12) but should be read with this in mind.
site/data.json was rebuilt at 14:00 (energy_nowar.json folded a no-war price factor into to_rus bmul), so its % of GDP widths differ from the brief; effect_on_map_pct_gdp gives both bases.
